QUOTE: `memory_buffer_alloc.c` is a built-in consumer of the runtime hook. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init()` installs its own calloc/free at lines 570-575 (a mutex-wrapped pair when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator's init function as installing its own calloc/free through the runtime setter. It doesn't say "only in-tree user", but it calls the allocator a "built-in consumer" and names no other consumer.
